---
description: Writing voice and fact-check rules for prose files
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

When writing or editing Markdown or any prose for human readers, follow
disciplines/10-writing-voice.md in full. Non-negotiable core: zero em
dashes (use a period, comma, colon, or parentheses); no slop vocabulary or
constructions (the canonical two-tier list and grep live in the discipline
file; run the grep on the draft before delivering); no hype, self-praise,
or unmeasured superlatives; vary sentence length; say each thing once; cut
10 to 20 percent after drafting. If the piece contains factual claims
(numbers, dates, names, "X does Y"), also run checklists/fact-check.md:
every claim verified against a source this session, flagged as unverified,
or deleted.
